description: This file implements a dispatcher for WebSocket requests, including handling resource mapping, sourcing handler files, and managing WebSocket handshake and data transfer processes.

classes.name: DispatchException
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during WebSocket request dispatching.

classes.name: _HandlerSuite
classes.description: Container class holding handler functions for handshake, data transfer, and passive closing handshake.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Main class responsible for dispatching WebSocket requests, managing handler mappings, and sourcing handler files.

methods.name: _default_passive_closing_handshake_handler
methods.description: Default handler for passive closing handshake, returns normal closure status.

methods.name: _normalize_path
methods.description: Converts a given path to an absolute normalized path with '/' separators.

methods.name: _create_path_to_resource_converter
methods.description: Creates a function to convert file paths to resource strings relative to a base directory.

methods.name: _enumerate_handler_file_paths
methods.description: Generator that yields paths of handler source files in a directory.

methods.name: _source_handler_file
methods.description: Sources handler functions from a string containing Python code.

methods.name: _extract_handler
methods.description: Extracts a callable handler by name from a dictionary.

methods.name: add_resource_path_alias
methods.description: Adds an alias for a resource path to point to an existing handler.

methods.name: source_warnings
methods.description: Returns warnings encountered during handler sourcing.

methods.name: do_extra_handshake
methods.description: Performs extra handshake processing based on request URI.

methods.name: transfer_data
methods.description: Handles data transfer for a WebSocket request.

methods.name: passive_closing_handshake
methods.description: Prepares response code and reason for client-initiated closing handshake.

methods.name: get_handler_suite
methods.description: Retrieves handler functions for a given resource, handling URI fragments and query strings.

methods.name: _source_handler_files_in_dir
methods.description: Sources all handler files in a directory and maps them to resources.
